rca_of_the_issue: ReferenceError: Flame is not defined at AnalyticsGrowthPage.jsx line 94 (tab config array). Root cause: 5 icons — Flame, TrendingDown, Repeat, FlaskConical, FileText — are referenced in the tab-icon config array and the PDF-button icon but were NEVER added to the lucide-react named-import list (lines 3-6). When React tried to evaluate the tab array during render, it hit the first undefined identifier and threw, tripping ErrorBoundary and showing the 'Ceva nu a mers cum trebuie' screen. This is a build-time issue that would have been caught by eslint 'no-undef' — the current lint config only reports on save and this file passed because 'no-undef' is not enforcing for JSX icon-component names. Fix (applied by tester): added `Flame, TrendingDown, Repeat, FlaskConical, FileText,` to the lucide-react import statement. Verified: page loads, all 8 tabs render with icons, no ErrorBoundary trip. Reproduction (before fix): login as admin → navigate to /admin/analytics-growth → whole page crashes to ErrorBoundary with 'Flame is not defined'. Mitigation: enable eslint no-undef in CI and add a smoke Playwright test that just loads /admin/analytics-growth and asserts data-testid='analytics-growth-page' is visible.
